02. This matter is taken up through Hybrid arrangement (video conferencing/physical mode).
Learned counsel for the State submitted that notice on the informant has been made sufficient.
None appears for the informant.
Heard learned counsel for the appellant and learned counsel for the State.

This is an appeal under section 14-A(2) of the S.C. & S.T. (PoA) Act, 1989 in connection with C.T.
Case No.56 of 2023 (Special Act) arising out of Narla P.S. Case No.170 of 2023 pending in the Court of the learned Sessions Judge -cum- Special Judge, Kalahandi, Bhawanipatna for offences punishable // 2 // under sections 376(2)(n)/294/506/34 of the I.P.C. read with section 3(1)(r)(s)/3(2)(va) of the S.C. & S.T. (PoA) Act.

entities.text: Court of the learned Sessions Judge -cum- Special Judge, Kalahandi, Bhawanipatna
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Considering the submission made by the learned counsel for the appellant that the appellant is in judicial custody since 18.08.2023 and he has been charge sheeted for the offences punishable under sections 376(2)(n)/294/506/34 of the I.P.C. and section 3(1)(r)(s)/3(2)(va) of the S.C. & S.T. (PoA)
Kuber Putel vs State Of Odisha on 14 November, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/148210538/
1 Act and after going through the 164 Cr.P.C. statement of the victim, aged about 26 years placed by the learned counsel for the State in which she has stated about her romantic relationship with the appellant for the last two years and also about her physical relationship with him and staying with him as his wife and other available materials on record, I am inclined to release the appellant on bail.
Let the appellant be released on bail in the aforesaid case on furnishing a bail bond of Rs.50,000/-
(rupees fifty thousand) with two local solvent sureties each for the like amount to the satisfaction of the learned Court in seisin over the matter

Violation of any of the conditions shall entail cancellation of bail.
The CRLA is accordingly disposed of.
